fixes.explanation: Not quite, friend, because the text goes the other way. "So the LORD spoke kind and comforting words to the angel who was speaking with me." Kind and comforting is a whole different kind of reply. Nothing hard or angry is spoken to him there (Zechariah 1:13).

Testing isn't in this promise. The LORD says, "the LORD will again comfort Zion and choose Jerusalem." The word is choose, friend. I think that's the promise: after the long years of anger, He says He will comfort Zion and choose Jerusalem.
